findings.finding: Preserved model-authored expected values omit the default temperature factor 300: expected D about .000732 versus independent/core .2197371130. MSD and RMS expectations inherit this error. CLI gates correctly reject these inconsistent cases; the package has no usable HTML.

The auxiliary conversion-coefficient unit is dimensionally inconsistent with D=C*T/(eta*a). The coefficient must carry diffusivity*viscosity*radius/temperature in the chosen units, equivalently mPa*micrometre^3/K; main D/MSD/RMS units are correct.

The preserved case title claims MSD/RMS unchanged when viscosity doubles at fixed time; physically MSD halves and RMS divides by sqrt(2). The main explanation/explorations elsewhere state the correct scaling.

Evidence uses the authored sentence introducing what the preceding passage identifies, not verbatim primary-paper prose. The one-axis RMS meaning is correct, but this quote must be marked as a paraphrase.

scope: These are numerical/source reviews of an unchanged partial lesson only. No page was created or hand-repaired; passing primary computations cannot override failed generated expectations and absent HTML.
